added.summary: `impostorBelow true` beside `impostor true` bakes the impostor's views from under the model's horizon too (the atlas twice as wide), for a model seen from below: on a cliff over the camera, hanging, flying.
A swaying model drawn as its impostor sways too, in the wind every vegetation tier reads; its card was still.

fixed.summary: An impostor seen from under its horizon draws whole, as the view from the horizon on an upright card; its trunk's foot and crown's edge drew as loose pieces. A swaying card bends from its foot as its mesh does; it leant as one straight quad, its foot sliding downwind.
